meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把标题、数据或地图变成动态短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想做会动的标题、图表或地图,又不想学专业软件
copy.tagline_en: Turn headlines, data, or maps into short animated videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to bring titles, charts, or maps to life without learning pro software.

howto.what: Claude 会按“计划→找素材→设计→构建→检查”自动做一条 10 秒内、无旁白的动态图形(文字动画、图表、地图、网页/UI 动画等),渲染前会问你先预览还是直接渲染,输出 MP4 或透明叠加层。
howto.when: 当你想做一条 10 秒内、无旁白、靠动效本身传话的短视频(如文字动画、数据图表、标志片头等)时触发;更长/带解说/多场景会转 /general-video,不确定走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这句话做成 10 秒的动效字幕:行动胜于言语。
say.note: 会做成文字动画,然后问你先预览还是渲染。

say.text: 用这份销售数据做一个柱状图增长的短视频。
say.note: 会先找素材,再设计图表动画并渲染。

say.text: 把这条新闻做成动画卡片,突出三个要点。
say.note: 会搜索新闻,做成头条揭示加要点标注。

howto.what_en: Claude plans and builds a short, unnarrated motion graphic (kinetic type, charts, logo, map/UI/news, etc.), verifies with lint/check/snapshots, asks preview or render, then outputs MP4 or transparent overlay.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants a short motion graphic (under 10s, no narration) where motion carries the message. Longer/narrated/multi-scene pieces go to /general-video; unclear goes via /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Animate this quote as 10s kinetic type: 'Actions speak louder than words.'
say_en.note: Builds the type animation and asks preview or render.

say_en.text: Turn this sales CSV into a bar-chart growth video.
say_en.note: Sources assets, designs the chart, then renders.

say_en.text: Make an animated card from this news, highlighting three facts.
say_en.note: It searches the news and builds headline plus callouts.
